purpose: Holdout candidates for DU-BENCH, kept separate from the development seeds that were already used to tune routing/selection rules. A sample is only holdout if it was NOT used to author rules or gold-fact iteration.
rules: Never mix a holdout sample's facts into rule design or threshold tuning.
Prefer existing local originals; never download and never fabricate a substitute.
A holdout company with no usable original is listed as UNAVAILABLE with an acquisition request, not replaced by a synthetic document.
Record SHA-256 at bind time so a later content change becomes UNAVAILABLE rather than a silent pass.
